character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Chibi 4-head-tall JRPG mage cadet, female, front view idle pose. Silver-white hair with pale ice-blue streaks, chin-length bob, round thin glasses. Ivory-white military academy dress-coat with navy-blue piping and trim, flared skirt, tall stiff collar with navy-blue necktie, dark gloves, dark navy tights, white heeled ankle boots. Sky-blue gem accents, ornate frost emblem. Calm cool expression, blue eyes. Dark-fantasy magic-school uniform, ivory-white and navy palette. Crisp pixel art, bold dark outline, flat cel shading.
